answer: To blunt sybils, each identity should publish a slowly revealed, key-bound compute receipt that others can independently re-run. Voting weight then requires endorsements from at least one established graph vertex that does not share recent funders with the applicant. Mass-created wallets tend to emit a simultaneous plume of near-identical receipts; those are tagged violet and earn no weight until later, staggered work appears. The delay plus the endorsement cost makes empty clones unprofitable.
